scripts.bootstrap: git submodule update --init --recursive && npm --prefix packages/widi ci && uv sync --dev
scripts.check: npm run check:workspace && npm run check:widi && npm run check:python
scripts.check:workspace: npm --prefix packages/widi exec -- biome check --config-path packages/widi/biome.json package.json scripts/run-widi.mjs scripts/widi-quality.mjs .widi-scholar/settings.json .widi-scholar/agent/models.json .widi-scholar/themes/prism.json
scripts.check:python: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format: npm run format:workspace && npm run format:widi && uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format:workspace: npm --prefix packages/widi exec -- biome check --write --config-path packages/widi/biome.json package.json scripts/run-widi.mjs scripts/widi-quality.mjs .widi-scholar/settings.json .widi-scholar/agent/models.json .widi-scholar/themes/prism.json
scripts.test:rpc: npm --prefix packages/widi --workspace apps/widi run test -- tests/rpc
